response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine distributed-systems depth (high-throughput microservices at Dunnhumby) and is currently hands-on building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling in an agentic workflow context, which directly matches the role's core mindset requirement. However, the resume shows no evidence of Python experience despite it being an explicit must-have, and there's little visible evidence of cross-functional stakeholder management, on-call/incident ownership, or agile ceremony participation, all of which are core non-technical requirements for this role.
strengths: Deep distributed systems experience handling millions of requests/sec with low-latency, async architectures
Current role directly involves AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow tooling
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and broad polyglot full-stack range
concerns: No evidence of Python skills anywhere in resume despite it being an explicit must-have
Little demonstrated experience in stakeholder management across product/leadership functions
No mention of on-call rotations, operational incident response, or agile/scrum ceremony experience
